QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_66

question.text: Exchanges generate alerts through surveillance databases for:

answer.text: Proactive risk management — detecting anomalies in positions, margins, and trading patterns

explanation.text: The Logic: Surveillance databases generate alerts that enable proactive risk management, including alerts on price and volume movements and on open-position build-up. These tools support market-integrity surveillance carried out by the exchange. The Trap: Alerts are not used for marketing, member rankings or price setting. They are risk-management signals used by the surveillance function. Note: Distributor/cross-exam coaching labels removed; replaced with neutral surveillance wording.
